text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said an article in the Wall Street Journal's "Heard on the Street" column was "misguided and missed the most important point" about Motorola Inc's cellular business.
-- the article posed the question "Are Motorola's best years in the past?"
-- Gruntal said Motorola owns 38 percent of the cellular subscriber market worldwide. This market is expected to grow by over 50 percent in 1997, Gruntal said.
-- Gruntal said Mototola's new revamped product line is meeting with enthusiastic demand.
-- Gruntal said Motorola is the "number one cellular equipment supplier worldwide, which is headed for a rapid growth mode."
-- said Motorola is the dominant supplier worldwide in other wireless markets.
-- Gruntal reiterated a strong buy rating on the stock.
